name: Valiant Communications Limited
summary: Valiant Communications Limited manufactures and markets communications equipment. The company provides synchronization and timing solutions, including GPS/GNSS/NavIC primary reference clocks, PTP 1588v2 grandmaster, PTP aware switch/PTP transparent clocks, and PTP slaves; grid protection and monitoring, such as teleprotection, IEE C37.94 line differential protection, phasor measurement units, and GRID islanding and WAMS solutions; and transmission and networking comprising IP/MPLS routers, IP multiplexers, SDH/PDH multiplexers, EDFA amplifiers, and ethernet failover systems.
